correct_completion: please do not hesitate to contact our support team.
full_sentence: Should you require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact our support team.
acceptable_variants: feel free to get in touch with our support team.
our support team is always available to help.

options.text: so you will not be helped.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result that has no logical link to the conditional offer of help set up by 'should'.
The simple past describes a previous event and cannot complete a conditional offer of future help.

options.text: please do not hesitate to contact our support team.
although you may be requiring help.
options.why_wrong: 'Although' signals concession, which contradicts the conditional meaning of 'should'. The verb form 'be requiring' is also unsuitable here.

grammar_focus: Inverted conditional with 'should' in formal register
explanation: Inversion with 'should' replaces 'if' in formal English. The main clause then takes an imperative or present form to make the offer, not a past form. Learners often add a concessive word, but the conditional meaning is already complete.
translation: Se por acaso você precisar de mais assistência, não hesite em entrar em contato com nossa equipe de suporte.
